name: markitdown
description: Agent skills for converting documents to Markdown with the MarkItDown CLI and Python API, running the markitdown-mcp server, and writing converter plugins.

interface.longDescription: Skills for Microsoft MarkItDown, the Python utility that converts PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, images, audio, EPub, ZIP and more into structure-preserving Markdown for LLM pipelines. Covers the markitdown CLI and Python API (including which optional extras to install and how to convert untrusted input safely), the markitdown-mcp server and its convert_to_markdown tool, and writing third-party converter plugins. Bundles the markitdown-mcp server.
defaultPrompt: Convert this PDF to Markdown with MarkItDown
Add the markitdown MCP server to my agent config
Write a MarkItDown plugin for a new file format
